# where esptool writes the everyday dev build. Slots are 4 MB (matches the old single-app size —
# firmware is ~2.4 MB today
column2: ~1.6 MB headroom); the LittleFS 'storage' area shrinks 11 MB -> 6.75 MB

column1: # to make room (still thousands of scripts / .sub files).
# ⚠ MIGRATION (one-time): the app offset moves 0x10000 -> 0x20000 AND the table + bootloader change
# so this must be flashed as THREE images
#     esptool ... write-flash 0x0 bootloader.bin 0x8000 partitions.bin 0x20000 firmware.bin
#     esptool ... erase-region 0xf000 0x2000        # clear otadata -> clean boot of ota_0
# 'nvs' keeps its exact offset/size (0x9000/0x6000) so write-flash never touches it → settings /
# passcode / Wi-Fi creds / bonds SURVIVE. The 'storage' region moved+shrank → LittleFS reformats
# (imported scripts are lost). AFTER migration the everyday dev-flash offset is 0x20000 (ota_0).
